tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen. Warm cream, so the lighter surface cards read as documents on a desk.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, dialogs. The default ground for text and data.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, sidebar, read-only fields, the demo toolbar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders; at least 3:1 against surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on paper, surface and surface-sunken. A warm near-black, never pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, timestamps, column headers. Passes 4.5:1 on surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: atlas-green
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary buttons, links, active navigation, selected tabs. One primary button per view.

tokens.name: atlas-green-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of atlas-green buttons and links.

tokens.name: atlas-green-soft
tokens.usage: Selected table rows, the seller's own listing highlight, subtle brand fills. Ink text on top.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on atlas-green fills.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Verification only: the Verified-by-company mark, Holding-verified badge, fair-value highlights. Never a button or link.

tokens.name: brass-soft
tokens.usage: Background of verification badges and the reference price panel header. Ink or brass text on top.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: State text and icons for waiting on someone else: Live, In review, ROFR pending, Awaiting company approval.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info badges and banners.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed states: Settled, Verified, Funded. Always paired with a label, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and completion banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs the current user's action or a deadline is near: Countered, Awaiting funds, under 48 hours left.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and deadline banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed or blocked: Rejected, Cancelled, Disputed, Buyer default, validation errors, destructive buttons.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges and error banners.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline on every interactive element, offset 2px.

tokens.name: chart-band
tokens.usage: Fill of the fair-value band on price charts and the bid ladder.

tokens.name: chart-above
tokens.usage: Bids and trades above the fair-value band. Blue, darker than chart-below, so the pair differs in lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: chart-below
tokens.usage: Bids and trades below the fair-value band. Orange, lighter than chart-above.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing and persona picker headline only.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page titles and company names at the top of a company page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, dialog titles, table group headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The company has 30 days to exercise its right of first refusal.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, helper text, timeline entries.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, column headers, badge text. Uppercase only in column headers.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Headline numbers: price per share, total value, fair-value midpoint. Always with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and bid ladders, right-aligned, tabular-nums.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Audit hashes, trade and escrow references, IDs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; inline padding of compact buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a page title; between major regions.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding and landing sections only.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, checkboxes, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, table containers, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, sheets and the trade room timeline panel.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows: surfaces are separated by line hairlines. Shadows exist only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts. Nothing that sits in the page flow.
